items.title: 3M commits $7.35 bln over 9 years to settle PFAS foam injury claims
items.summary: Investing.com-- 3M said on Tuesday it has agreed to settle the bulk of personal injury claims in the sprawling U.S. litigation over PFAS “forever chemicals” in firefighting foam, committing $7.35 billion over nine years.
